items.name: browser
items.descriptionEn: Browser lets ChatGPT open and control the in-app browser, mainly for local development pages and files. Use it to navigate, inspect, click, type, and take screenshots while testing pages inside ChatGPT.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 控制 Codex 内置浏览器：打开本地网页、点击、输入、截图，主要用于测试前端页面。

items.name: control-in-app-browser
items.descriptionEn: Control the in-app Browser for opening, navigating, inspecting visible or interactive page state, clicking, typing, screenshots, and local web testing. It can have existing signed-in sessions. For semantic operations on linked resources, prefer a purpose-built connector, API, or CLI when available.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 控制应用内浏览器：打开页面、点击、输入、截图、本地网页测试。

items.name: visualize
items.descriptionEn: Create interactive charts, maps, diagrams, simulations, 3D models, data explorers, and UI previews directly in your conversation. Filter data, select details, compare scenarios, and adjust inputs to see how the result changes.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 在对话里直接生成图表、地图、模拟器、交互式工具和 UI 预览，适合做演示和探索。

items.name: codex-security
items.descriptionEn: Codex Security packages reusable workflows for security scans, analysis, validation, and investigation across code, diffs, and related artifacts.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 安全插件：对代码库/PR 做安全扫描、威胁建模、漏洞分析，自带 12 个配套技能。

items.name: attack-path-analysis
items.descriptionEn: Use when Codex is already in the attack-path-analysis phase of a security scan or the user explicitly asks to trace a security finding from source to sink and calibrate severity. Do not use as the primary trigger for full PR, commit, branch, patch, or repository scans.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 安全扫描环节：追踪漏洞从源头到出口，校准严重级别。

items.name: deep-security-scan
items.descriptionEn: Use when the user asks for a deep, exhaustive, multi-pass, or variance-reducing repository-wide or scoped-path Codex Security scan. Run repeated independent discovery passes over one resolved scope with worker-specific threat models, semantically merge candidates, synthesize one canonical validation threat model, then run validation, attack-path analysis, canonical JSON completion, and generated reporting once. Do not use for PRs, commits, branch diffs, or working-tree diffs.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 深度安全扫描：多轮独立扫描降低漏报率。

items.name: finding-discovery
items.descriptionEn: Use when Codex is already in the finding-discovery phase of a security scan or the user explicitly asks to discover candidate security findings in a repository or code change. Do not use as the primary trigger for full PR, commit, branch, patch, or repository scans.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 在代码库中发掘候选安全问题。

items.name: fix-finding
items.descriptionEn: Use when the user explicitly asks to fix and verify a validated or plausible security finding. Do not use as the primary trigger for full PR, commit, branch, patch, or repository scans.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 修复并验证一个安全发现。

items.name: propose-security-hardening
items.descriptionEn: Develop evidence-backed structural and architectural security hardening proposals from vulnerability disclosures, supplied findings, incident or assessment documents, source code, or a completed Codex Security scan. Use when a user asks for systemic improvements, alternatives beyond per-finding patches, before-and-after security architecture views, engineering tradeoff analysis, or an implementation-ready plan for a selected hardening option. Also use automatically after a Codex Security scan with reportable findings when the top-level scan workflow requests final-report hardening guidance.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 基于证据提出结构性安全加固方案。

items.name: security-diff-scan
items.descriptionEn: Use when the user asks for a security review of a pull request, commit, branch diff, working-tree patch, or other Git-backed change set.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 对 PR/提交/分支差异做安全审查。

items.name: security-scan
items.descriptionEn: Use for a standard, single-pass security audit of an entire repository or a scoped path, package folder, or submodule with no diff to review.  This is the default repository scan.  Do not use for PR/commit/branch/working-tree diffs, or for deep, multi-pass, or variance-reducing scans.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 默认的整库单轮安全审计。

items.name: threat-model
items.descriptionEn: Use when Codex is already in the threat-modeling phase of a security scan, the user explicitly invokes $threat-model, or the user explicitly asks to create, update, or persist a repository threat model. Do not use as the primary trigger for full PR, commit, branch, patch, or repository scans.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 建立或更新仓库的威胁模型。

items.name: track-findings
items.descriptionEn: Track validated Codex Security findings in Linear, Jira, GitHub issues, or draft GitHub security advisories. Use it for one finding or an explicitly selected batch of up to 25 findings tracked as Linear, Jira, or GitHub issues. Includes duplicate checks, exact previews, approval-gated writes, and readback. Do not use it for scans or fixes.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 把安全发现跟踪到 Linear/Jira/GitHub 里。

items.name: triage-finding
items.descriptionEn: Use when the user supplies or imports existing security findings, vulnerability reports, or security/vulnerability Jira/Linear tickets from scanners, advisories, GitHub, Atlassian Rovo, Linear, or similar backlog sources and wants static repo-impact triage. Do not use for discovery, duplicate-bug triage, validation, or fixes.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 对导入的漏洞报告做分级处理。

items.name: validation
items.descriptionEn: Use when Codex is already in the validation phase of a security scan or the user explicitly asks to determine whether one or more candidate security findings are valid. Do not use as the primary trigger for full PR, commit, branch, patch, or repository scans.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 验证候选安全问题是否真实、是否值得修。

items.name: vulnerability-writeup
items.descriptionEn: Write up vulnerabilities from disclosure documents, rough notes, supplied findings, PoCs, source code, or Codex Security scan output into polished, self-contained, source-backed reports. Use for one vulnerability or a disclosure campaign; a Codex Security scan is optional.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 把漏洞信息写成规范、有据可查的漏洞报告。

items.name: github
items.descriptionEn: Use GitHub to inspect repositories, review pull requests, address feedback, debug failing Actions checks, and prepare code changes for review through a connector-first workflow with targeted CLI fallbacks.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: GitHub 集成：查看仓库、审查 PR、回复评审意见、调试 Actions 失败、发布改动。

items.name: gh-address-comments
items.descriptionEn: Address actionable GitHub pull request review feedback. Use when the user wants to inspect unresolved review threads, requested changes, or inline review comments on a PR, then implement selected fixes. Use the GitHub app for PR metadata and flat comment reads, and use the bundled GraphQL script via `gh` whenever thread-level state, resolution status, or inline review context matters.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 处理 GitHub PR 上的评审意见：查看未解决讨论、实现修复。

items.name: gh-fix-ci
items.descriptionEn: Use when a user asks to debug or fix failing GitHub PR checks that run in GitHub Actions. Use the GitHub app from this plugin for PR metadata and patch context, and use `gh` for Actions check and log inspection before implementing any approved fix.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 排查并修复 GitHub Actions 里失败的检查。

items.name: yeet
items.descriptionEn: Publish local changes to GitHub by confirming scope, committing intentionally, pushing the branch, and opening a draft PR through the GitHub app from this plugin, with `gh` used only as a fallback where connector coverage is insufficient.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 把本地改动一键提交、推送并开草稿 PR。

items.name: sentry
items.descriptionEn: Use Sentry skills to inspect recent issues, review events, and summarize production errors with a read-only workflow.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 接入 Sentry 错误监控：查看线上报错、审查事件、汇总生产环境错误。

items.name: superpowers
items.descriptionEn: Use Superpowers to guide agent work through brainstorming, implementation planning, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel execution, code review, and finish-the-branch workflows.
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: Agent 工作流引擎：头脑风暴 → 写计划 → TDD 实现 → 验证，配套 14 个技能。

items.name: brainstorming
items.descriptionEn: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 头脑风暴工作流：系统化梳理想法，想清楚再动手。

items.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
items.descriptionEn: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 把任务拆给多个并行子代理同时干活，提高效率。

items.name: executing-plans
items.descriptionEn: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 按写好的计划逐步执行实现，边做边验证。

items.name: finishing-a-development-branch
items.descriptionEn: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work - guides completion of development work by presenting structured options for merge, PR, or cleanup
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 开发分支收尾：验证、整理、提交，干净地结束一个分支。

items.name: receiving-code-review
items.descriptionEn: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 以正确心态接收代码评审意见，并逐条改进。

items.name: requesting-code-review
items.descriptionEn: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 发起高质量的代码评审请求，让别人能高效审查。

items.name: subagent-driven-development
items.descriptionEn: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 子代理驱动开发：主代理负责调度，子代理负责具体实现。

items.name: systematic-debugging
items.descriptionEn: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 系统化排错：先复现 → 找根因 → 再修复，不瞎猜。

items.name: test-driven-development
items.descriptionEn: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: TDD：先写测试再写实现（红-绿-重构循环）。

items.name: using-git-worktrees
items.descriptionEn: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 用 git worktree 建隔离工作区，多个任务并行开发互不干扰。

items.name: using-superpowers
items.descriptionEn: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring Skill tool invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 对话开始时的引导技能：先找可用技能再响应，而不是直接开干。

items.name: verification-before-completion
items.descriptionEn: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 声称"做完了"之前必须跑验证命令，用证据说话。

items.name: writing-plans
items.descriptionEn: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 动手写代码前，把需求拆成可执行的多步骤计划。

items.name: writing-skills
items.descriptionEn: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
items.author: Jesse Vincent
items.notesZh: 创建、编辑、验证技能的全流程指导。

items.name: vercel
items.descriptionEn: Bring Vercel ecosystem guidance into Codex with curated skills and the connected Vercel app. Packages the upstream vercel/vercel-plugin skills, agents, and commands under the local `vercel` plugin identity for the Codex plugin marketplace.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel 平台全家桶：部署、环境变量、数据库、Next.js、AI SDK 等 47 个参考技能。

items.name: agent-browser
items.descriptionEn: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, verify dev server output, test web apps, navigate pages, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, extract data, or automate any browser task. Also triggers when a dev server starts so you can verify it visually.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 浏览器自动化 CLI：操作网页、填表、截图、抓数据。

items.name: agent-browser-verify
items.descriptionEn: Automated browser verification for dev servers. Triggers when a dev server starts to run a visual gut-check with agent-browser — verifies the page loads, checks for console errors, validates key UI elements, and reports pass/fail before continuing.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 开发服务器启动后自动用浏览器做可视化验证，检查页面和控制台报错。

items.name: ai-elements
items.descriptionEn: AI Elements component library guidance — pre-built React components for AI interfaces built on shadcn/ui. Use when building chat UIs, message displays, tool call rendering, streaming responses, reasoning panels, or any AI-native interface with the AI SDK.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: AI 界面组件库（基于 shadcn/ui）：聊天界面、工具调用展示等。

items.name: ai-gateway
items.descriptionEn: Vercel AI Gateway expert guidance. Use when configuring model routing, provider failover, cost tracking, or managing multiple AI providers through a unified API.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: AI 网关：多模型路由、故障切换、成本跟踪，统一 API 管理。

items.name: ai-generation-persistence
items.descriptionEn: AI generation persistence patterns — unique IDs, addressable URLs, database storage, and cost tracking for every LLM generation
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: LLM 生成内容的持久化：唯一 ID、可寻址 URL、数据库存储。

items.name: ai-sdk
items.descriptionEn: Vercel AI SDK expert guidance. Use when building AI-powered features — chat interfaces, text generation, structured output, tool calling, agents, MCP integration, streaming, embeddings, reranking, image generation, or working with any LLM provider.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel AI SDK：构建聊天、流式输出、工具调用、智能体等 AI 功能。

items.name: auth
items.descriptionEn: Authentication integration guidance — Clerk (native Vercel Marketplace), Descope, and Auth0 setup for Next.js applications. Covers middleware auth patterns, sign-in/sign-up flows, and Marketplace provisioning. Use when implementing user authentication.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 认证集成：Clerk、Auth0 等登录方案接入 Next.js。

items.name: bootstrap
items.descriptionEn: Project bootstrapping orchestrator for repos that depend on Vercel-linked resources (databases, auth, and managed integrations). Use when setting up or repairing a repository so linking, environment provisioning, env pulls, and first-run db/dev commands happen in the correct safe order.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 项目引导：初始化依赖 Vercel 资源（数据库/认证）的仓库环境。

items.name: chat-sdk
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Chat SDK expert guidance. Use when building multi-platform chat bots — Slack, Telegram, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Google Chat, GitHub, Linear — with a single codebase. Covers the Chat class, adapters, threads, messages, cards, modals, streaming, state management, and webhook setup.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Chat SDK：一套代码对接 Slack、Telegram、Discord 等多平台聊天机器人。

items.name: cms
items.descriptionEn: Headless CMS integration guidance — Sanity (native Vercel Marketplace), Contentful, DatoCMS, Storyblok, and Builder.io. Covers studio setup, content modeling, preview mode, revalidation webhooks, and Visual Editing. Use when building content-driven sites with a headless CMS on Vercel.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 无头 CMS 集成：Sanity、Contentful 等内容系统接入。

items.name: cron-jobs
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Cron Jobs configuration and best practices. Use when adding, editing, or debugging scheduled tasks in vercel.json.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel Cron 定时任务：在 vercel.json 里配置定时执行。

items.name: deployments-cicd
items.descriptionEn: Vercel deployment and CI/CD expert guidance. Use when deploying, promoting, rolling back, inspecting deployments, building with --prebuilt, or configuring CI workflow files for Vercel.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 部署与 CI/CD：发布、回滚、检查部署、配置 CI 工作流。

items.name: email
items.descriptionEn: Email sending integration guidance — Resend (native Vercel Marketplace) with React Email templates. Covers API setup, transactional emails, domain verification, and template patterns. Use when sending emails from a Vercel-deployed application.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 邮件发送：Resend + React Email 模板，验证域名发事务邮件。

items.name: env-vars
items.descriptionEn: Vercel environment variable expert guidance. Use when working with .env files, vercel env commands, OIDC tokens, or managing environment-specific configuration.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel 环境变量管理：.env 文件、vercel env 命令、OIDC。

items.name: geist
items.descriptionEn: Expert guidance for Geist, Vercel's default typography system and font family for precise Next.js interfaces. Use when configuring Geist Sans, Geist Mono, or Geist Pixel, setting up font imports, or applying Vercel typography and aesthetic guidance.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Geist 字体/排版系统：Vercel 默认字体配置。

items.name: geistdocs
items.descriptionEn: Expert guidance for Geistdocs, Vercel's documentation template built with Next.js and Fumadocs — MDX authoring, configuration, AI chat, i18n, feedback, deployment. Use when creating documentation sites, configuring geistdocs, writing MDX content, or setting up docs infrastructure.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Geistdocs 文档站模板：MDX 写作、AI 聊天、i18n、部署。

items.name: investigation-mode
items.descriptionEn: Orchestrated debugging coordinator. Triggers on frustration signals (stuck, hung, broken, waiting) and systematically triages: runtime logs → workflow status → browser verify → deploy/env. Reports findings at every step.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 卡住/报错时的系统性排查：日志→工作流→浏览器验证→环境，逐步定位。

items.name: json-render
items.descriptionEn: AI chat response rendering guidance — handling UIMessage parts, tool call displays, streaming states, and structured data presentation. Use when building custom chat UIs, rendering tool results, or troubleshooting AI response display issues.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: AI 聊天回复渲染：工具调用、流式状态、结构化数据展示。

items.name: marketplace
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Marketplace expert guidance — discovering, installing, and building integrations, auto-provisioned environment variables, unified billing, and the vercel integration CLI. Use when consuming third-party services, building custom integrations, or managing marketplace resources on Vercel.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel Marketplace：接入第三方服务、自动配置环境变量、统一计费。

items.name: micro
items.descriptionEn: Expert guidance for micro — asynchronous HTTP microservices framework by Vercel. Use when building lightweight HTTP servers, API endpoints, or microservices using the micro library.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: micro 框架：Vercel 出品的轻量异步 HTTP 微服务。

items.name: ncc
items.descriptionEn: Expert guidance for @vercel/ncc — a simple CLI for compiling Node.js modules into a single file with all dependencies included. Use when bundling serverless functions, CLI tools, or any Node.js project into a self-contained file.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: @vercel/ncc：把 Node.js 项目打包成单个自包含文件。

items.name: next-forge
items.descriptionEn: next-forge expert guidance — production-grade Turborepo monorepo SaaS starter by Vercel. Use when working in a next-forge project, scaffolding with `npx next-forge init`, or editing @repo/* workspace packages.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: next-forge 模板：生产级 Turborepo monorepo SaaS 起步套件。

items.name: nextjs
items.descriptionEn: Next.js App Router expert guidance. Use when building, debugging, or architecting Next.js applications — routing, Server Components, Server Actions, Cache Components, layouts, middleware/proxy, data fetching, rendering strategies, and deployment on Vercel.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Next.js App Router 全面指南：路由、服务端组件、数据获取、渲染。

items.name: observability
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Observability expert guidance — Drains (logs, traces, speed insights, web analytics), Web Analytics, Speed Insights, runtime logs, custom events, OpenTelemetry integration, and monitoring dashboards. Use when instrumenting, debugging, or optimizing application performance and user experience on Vercel.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel 可观测性：日志、速度洞察、Web 分析、OpenTelemetry、监控仪表盘。

items.name: payments
items.descriptionEn: Stripe payments integration guidance — native Vercel Marketplace setup, checkout sessions, webhook handling, subscription billing, and the Stripe SDK. Use when implementing payments, subscriptions, or processing transactions.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Stripe 支付集成：结账、Webhook、订阅计费。

items.name: react-best-practices
items.descriptionEn: React best-practices reviewer for TSX files. Triggers after editing multiple TSX components to run a condensed quality checklist covering component structure, hooks usage, accessibility, performance, and TypeScript patterns.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: React/TSX 组件质量检查清单：结构、hooks、无障碍、性能。

items.name: routing-middleware
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Routing Middleware guidance — request interception before cache, rewrites, redirects, personalization. Works with any framework. Supports Edge, Node.js, and Bun runtimes. Use when intercepting requests at the platform level.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 路由中间件：请求拦截、重写、重定向、个性化。

items.name: runtime-cache
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Runtime Cache API guidance — ephemeral per-region key-value cache with tag-based invalidation. Shared across Functions, Routing Middleware, and Builds. Use when implementing caching strategies beyond framework-level caching.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Runtime Cache：按区域的临时 KV 缓存，支持按标签失效。

items.name: satori
items.descriptionEn: Expert guidance for Satori — Vercel's library that converts HTML and CSS to SVG, commonly used to generate dynamic OG images for Next.js and other frameworks.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Satori：把 HTML/CSS 转成 SVG，常用于动态生成 OG 分享图。

items.name: shadcn
items.descriptionEn: shadcn/ui expert guidance — CLI, component installation, composition patterns, custom registries, theming, Tailwind CSS integration, and high-quality interface design. Use when initializing shadcn, adding components, composing product UI, building custom registries, configuring themes, or troubleshooting component issues.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: shadcn/ui 组件库：CLI 安装、主题定制、Tailwind 集成。

items.descriptionEn: Sign in with Vercel guidance — OAuth 2.0/OIDC identity provider for user authentication via Vercel accounts. Use when implementing user login with Vercel as the identity provider.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 用 Vercel 账号做 OAuth/OIDC 登录。

items.name: swr
items.descriptionEn: SWR data-fetching expert guidance. Use when building React apps with client-side data fetching, caching, revalidation, mutations, optimistic UI, pagination, or infinite loading using the SWR library.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: SWR 数据请求库：缓存、重验证、乐观更新、无限加载。

items.name: turbopack
items.descriptionEn: Turbopack expert guidance. Use when configuring the Next.js bundler, optimizing HMR, debugging build issues, or understanding the Turbopack vs Webpack differences.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Turbopack 打包器：配置、HMR 优化、与 Webpack 的差异。

items.name: turborepo
items.descriptionEn: Turborepo expert guidance. Use when setting up or optimizing monorepo builds, configuring task caching, remote caching, parallel execution, or the --affected flag for incremental CI.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Turborepo 多仓库构建：任务缓存、远程缓存、并行执行。

items.name: v0-dev
items.descriptionEn: v0 by Vercel expert guidance. Use when discussing AI code generation, generating UI components from prompts, v0 CLI usage, v0 SDK/API integration, or integrating v0 into development workflows with GitHub and Vercel deployment.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: v0：用提示词生成 UI 组件的 AI 工具，可接入开发流程。

items.name: vercel-agent
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Agent guidance — AI-powered code review, incident investigation, and SDK installation. Automates PR analysis and anomaly debugging. Use when configuring or understanding Vercel's AI development tools.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel Agent：AI 代码审查、故障调查、SDK 安装。

items.name: vercel-api
items.descriptionEn: Vercel app and REST API expert guidance. Use when the agent needs live access to Vercel projects, deployments, environment variables, domains, logs, or documentation through the connected Vercel app or REST API.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel REST API：获取项目、部署、环境变量、日志等数据。

items.name: vercel-cli
items.descriptionEn: Vercel CLI expert guidance. Use when deploying, managing environment variables, linking projects, viewing logs, managing domains, or interacting with the Vercel platform from the command line.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel 命令行：部署、环境变量、域名、日志管理。

items.name: vercel-firewall
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Firewall and security expert guidance. Use when configuring DDoS protection, WAF rules, rate limiting, bot filtering, IP allow/block lists, OWASP rulesets, Attack Challenge Mode, or any security configuration on the Vercel platform.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel 防火墙：DDoS 防护、WAF 规则、限流、IP 黑白名单。

items.name: vercel-flags
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Flags guidance — feature flags platform with unified dashboard, Flags Explorer, gradual rollouts, A/B testing, and provider adapters. Use when implementing feature flags, experimentation, or staged rollouts.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 特性开关平台：灰度发布、A/B 测试、统一仪表盘。

items.name: vercel-functions
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Functions expert guidance — Serverless Functions, Edge Functions, Fluid Compute, streaming, Cron Jobs, and runtime configuration. Use when configuring, debugging, or optimizing server-side code running on Vercel.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel 函数：Serverless/Edge 函数、流式、运行时配置。

items.name: vercel-queues
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Queues guidance (public beta) — durable event streaming with topics, consumer groups, retries, and delayed delivery. $0.60/1M ops. Powers Workflow DevKit. Use when building async processing, fan-out patterns, or event-driven architectures.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel 队列：异步事件流、重试、延迟投递、扇出模式。

items.name: vercel-sandbox
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Sandbox guidance — ephemeral Firecracker microVMs for running untrusted code safely. Supports AI agents, code generation, and experimentation. Use when executing user-generated or AI-generated code in isolation.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel Sandbox：隔离微虚拟机安全运行不可信代码。

items.name: vercel-services
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Services — deploy multiple services within a single Vercel project. Use for monorepo layouts or when combining a backend (Python, Go) with a frontend (Next.js, Vite) in one deployment.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 单项目部署多服务：后端(Python/Go) + 前端(Next.js) 混合。

items.name: vercel-storage
items.descriptionEn: Vercel storage expert guidance — Blob, Edge Config, and Marketplace storage (Neon Postgres, Upstash Redis). Use when choosing, configuring, or using data storage with Vercel applications.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Vercel 存储：Blob、Edge Config、数据库（Neon/Upstash）选择与接入。

items.name: verification
items.descriptionEn: Full-story verification — infers what the user is building, then verifies the complete flow end-to-end: browser → API → data → response. Triggers on dev server start and 'why isn't this working' signals.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: 全链路端到端验证：浏览器 → API → 数据 → 响应，发现"怎么不工作"的问题。

items.name: workflow
items.descriptionEn: Vercel Workflow DevKit (WDK) expert guidance. Use when building durable workflows, long-running tasks, API routes or agents that need pause/resume, retries, step-based execution, or crash-safe orchestration with Vercel Workflow.
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.notesZh: Workflow DevKit：持久化工作流、长任务、暂停/恢复、重试。

items.name: documents
items.descriptionEn: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export DOCX document artifacts locally. Use Documents when the durable output or target is a document, doc, docs, Word file, Google Doc, Google Docs document, memo, report, or writing artifact.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 在本地创建/编辑/检查 Word(.docx) 文档，可生成 Google Docs 交接版本。

items.name: pdf
items.descriptionEn: Read, create, inspect, render, verify, and extract content from PDF files locally. Use PDF when the durable output or target is a PDF file and visual layout fidelity matters.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 在本地读取、创建、渲染、校验 PDF 文件，适合对排版效果有要求的场景。

items.name: presentations
items.descriptionEn: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export presentation slide decks locally, including PPTX authoring and native Google Slides handoff guidance. Use Presentations when the durable output or target is a deck, slidedeck, presentation deck, slide deck, slides, PowerPoint, Google Slides, presentation, speaker notes, or visual deck repair.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 创建/编辑 PPT 幻灯片（.pptx），可生成 Google Slides 交接版本。

items.name: spreadsheets
items.descriptionEn: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export XLSX, CSV, and TSV spreadsheets locally, including local XLSX authoring for native Google Sheets handoff. Use Spreadsheets when the durable output or target is a spreadsheet, workbook, sheet, Google Sheet, or CSV file. Use Excel Live Control for working on a spreadsheet open in Microsoft Excel app, through the ChatGPT add-in.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 创建/编辑 Excel(.xlsx)、CSV、TSV 表格，可生成 Google Sheets 交接版本。

items.name: excel-live-control
items.descriptionEn: Control an open or active Microsoft Excel workbook through the ChatGPT add-in or connected session. Use when the user tags the Microsoft Excel app in Codex or follows up on an established live Excel task. Do not use for standalone spreadsheet files or Google Sheets.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 实时控制已打开的 Excel 应用（需安装 ChatGPT 的 Excel 插件）。

items.name: template-creator
items.descriptionEn: Use Template Creator to create reusable templates from documents, spreadsheets, presentations, ImageGen or Product Design images, emails, and Slack messages. Template Creator preserves the structure, voice, layout, and style of your reference so you can quickly create new versions whenever you need them.
items.author: OpenAI
items.notesZh: 把文档/表格/PPT/图片/邮件变成可复用的个人模板技能，以后一键套用。

items.name: ponytail
items.descriptionEn: Prefer YAGNI, the standard library, native platform features, and the smallest correct implementation.
items.author: Dietrich Gebert
items.notesZh: 极简开发哲学：优先标准库、YAGNI、最小可用实现，配套 audit/review/debt 等技能。

items.name: ponytail-audit
items.descriptionEn:
Whole-repo audit for over-engineering. Like ponytail-review, but scans the
entire codebase instead of a diff: a ranked list of what to delete, simplify,
or replace with stdlib/native equivalents. Use when the user says "audit this
codebase", "audit for over-engineering", "what can I delete from this repo",
"find bloat", "ponytail-audit", or "/ponytail-audit". One-shot report, does
not apply fixes.
items.author: Dietrich Gebert
items.notesZh: 整库审查"过度工程"：列出该删、该简化、该换标准库的地方。

items.name: ponytail-debt
items.descriptionEn:
Harvest every `ponytail:` comment in the codebase into a debt ledger, so the
deliberate shortcuts and deferrals ponytail leaves behind get tracked instead
of rotting into "later means never". Use when the user says "ponytail debt",
"/ponytail-debt", "what did ponytail defer", "list the shortcuts", "ponytail
ledger", or "what did we mark to do later". One-shot report, changes nothing.
items.author: Dietrich Gebert
items.notesZh: 把代码里标记的 ponytail: 欠债注释汇总成债务清单，防止"以后再说"变永远不做。

items.name: ponytail-gain
items.descriptionEn:
Show ponytail's measured impact as a compact scoreboard: less code, less
cost, more speed, from the benchmark medians. One-shot display, not a
persistent mode, and not a per-repo number. Trigger: /ponytail-gain,
"ponytail gain", "what does ponytail save", "show ponytail impact",
"ponytail scoreboard".
items.author: Dietrich Gebert
items.notesZh: 展示极简方案带来的量化收益：更少代码、更低成本、更快速度。

items.name: ponytail-help
items.descriptionEn:
Quick-reference card for all ponytail modes, skills, and commands.
One-shot display, not a persistent mode. Trigger: /ponytail-help,
"ponytail help", "what ponytail commands", "how do I use ponytail".
items.author: Dietrich Gebert
items.notesZh: ponytail 全家桶速查卡：所有模式、技能、命令一览。

items.name: ponytail-review
items.descriptionEn:
Code review focused exclusively on over-engineering. Finds what to delete:
reinvented standard library, unneeded dependencies, speculative abstractions,
dead flexibility. One line per finding: location, what to cut, what replaces
it. Use when the user says "review for over-engineering", "what can we
delete", "is this over-engineered", "simplify review", or invokes
/ponytail-review. Complements correctness-focused review, this one only
hunts complexity.
items.author: Dietrich Gebert
items.notesZh: 只找"过度工程"的代码评审：该删什么、用什么替代，一条一行。

items.name: baseline-ui
items.descriptionEn: Quickly deslop UI code by fixing spacing, hierarchy, typography, and small layout issues. Use when the interface needs a fast cleanup or polish pass.
items.notesZh: 快速给界面"去糙"：修间距、层级、字体、小布局问题。

items.name: fixing-accessibility
items.descriptionEn: Audit and fix HTML accessibility issues including ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus management, color contrast, and form errors. Use when adding interactive controls, forms, dialogs, or reviewing WCAG compliance.
items.notesZh: 修复网页无障碍问题：标签、键盘操作、焦点管理、对比度、表单错误。

items.name: fixing-metadata
items.descriptionEn:
Audit and fix HTML metadata including page titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph
tags, Twitter cards, favicons, JSON-LD structured data, and robots directives. Use when adding
SEO metadata, fixing social share previews, reviewing Open Graph tags, setting up canonical URLs,
or shipping new pages that need correct meta tags.
items.notesZh: 修复网页元信息：标题、SEO 描述、OG 标签、favicon、JSON-LD。

items.name: fixing-motion-performance
items.descriptionEn: Audit and fix animation performance issues including layout thrashing, compositor properties, scroll-linked motion, and blur effects. Use when animations stutter, transitions jank, or reviewing CSS/JS animation performance.
items.notesZh: 修复动画卡顿：避免布局抖动、用合成器属性、优化模糊效果。

items.name: hallmark
items.descriptionEn: Anti-AI-slop design skill for greenfield pages, audits, redesigns, and design extraction from URLs or screenshots. Use when the user asks to build a new app or landing page, wants to redesign something, invokes Hallmark by name, or uses audit/redesign/study.
items.notesZh: 高品质网页设计：从零新建、重设计、从截图/网址提取设计风格。

items.name: full-output-enforcement
items.descriptionEn: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Universal overlay skill - apply to ANY task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output (full files, all components, no placeholders). Does not conflict with design skills.
items.notesZh: 长任务输出保障：强制完整代码、禁止占位符、处理超长输出拆分。

items.name: redesign-existing-projects
items.descriptionEn: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Use ONLY for EXISTING projects the user wants improved. If the user wants a brand-new page built from scratch, use design-taste-frontend instead. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.
items.notesZh: 把已有网站/应用升级到高级质感（只用于已有项目，不用于从零新建）。

items.name: security-audit
items.descriptionEn: 代码安全专项审计技能。检查敏感信息与个人信息泄露（密钥/口令/私钥/身份证/手机号/邮箱等）、SQL 与命令注入风险、配置文件明文敏感信息、以及其它高危安全隐患（危险函数/弱加密/不安全随机数/路径穿越/日志泄露等），输出分级中文报告并给出转诊建议。Use when 用户要求检查代码中的敏感信息或个人信息泄露风险、检查 SQL 注入等安全漏洞、审计配置文件明文密钥、做代码安全体检或安全审计。不限语言，纯只读不联网，不依赖 git 变更。

items.name: skill-installer
items.descriptionEn: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos).
items.notesZh: 安装技能：从官方列表或 GitHub 仓库装到 .codex/skills。

items.name: design-taste-frontend
items.descriptionEn: Anti-slop frontend skill for NEW (greenfield) landing pages, portfolios, and interfaces. Reads the brief, infers design direction, and ships non-templated UI. Use ONLY when the user asks to build or style something NEW from scratch. If the user wants to redesign or upgrade an EXISTING project, use redesign-existing-projects instead. Strict pre-flight check.
items.notesZh: 从零设计新网页/落地页/作品集，拒绝模板感（只用于新建）。

items.name: unit-test
items.descriptionEn: 代码健康体检技能。对项目执行单元/代码做通用健康检查，查找漏洞、结构性错误、健壮性/安全/性能/可维护性问题，并评估基础测试覆盖，输出分级中文报告（严重/警告/建议），然后按需转诊给 tdd（写测试）、code-review（审变更）、diagnosing-bugs（查疑难 bug）、improve-codebase-architecture（改结构）。Use when 用户要求检查代码质量、找漏洞或结构性错误、做代码体检、评估测试是否够用、检查某个执行单元/模块/函数的代码健康度。不限语言，不依赖 git 变更，纯只读不联网。

items.name: imagegen
items.descriptionEn: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.
items.notesZh: 生成/编辑位图图片：插画、纹理、素材、模拟图、透明底图。

items.name: openai-docs
items.descriptionEn: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex.
items.notesZh: 查询 Codex/OpenAI 官方知识：模型、定价、设置、自动化、技能等。

items.name: plugin-creator
items.descriptionEn: Create and scaffold plugin directories for Codex with a required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, optional plugin folders/files, valid manifest defaults, and personal-marketplace entries by default. Use when Codex needs to create a new personal plugin, add optional plugin structure, generate or update marketplace entries for plugin ordering and availability metadata, or update an existing local plugin during development with the CLI-driven cachebuster and reinstall flow.
items.notesZh: 创建 Codex 插件：自动生成 plugin.json 和插件目录结构。

items.name: review-agent
items.descriptionEn: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.
items.notesZh: 只读审查代码改动，输出每条可执行的缺陷清单。

items.name: skill-creator
items.descriptionEn: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Codex's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
items.notesZh: 指导你创建或更新一个技能。

items.name: agent-reach
items.descriptionEn:
MUST USE when user wants to 调研/research/搜索/search/查/找/look up anything
on the internet — e.g. 全网调研 X / 帮我调研一下 X / 查一下 X / 搜搜 X /
看看大家怎么评价 X / X 上有什么讨论 / research this topic。

Also MUST USE when user mentions any platform or shares any URL/链接:
小红书/xiaohongshu/xhs, Twitter/推特/X, B站/bilibili, Reddit, Facebook,
Instagram, V2EX, LinkedIn/领英/招聘/求职/jobs, YouTube, GitHub code search, 小宇宙播客,
雪球/股票行情, RSS feeds, or any web URL.

15 platforms, multi-backend routing (OpenCLI / per-platform CLIs / APIs).
Zero config for 6 channels. Run `agent-reach doctor --json` to see which
backend serves each platform right now.

NOT for: 写报告/数据分析/翻译等内容加工（本 skill 只负责从互联网获取内容）；
发帖/评论/点赞等写操作；已有专门 skill 的平台（先用专门 skill）。

【路由方式】SKILL.md 包含路由表和常用命令，复杂场景需按需阅读对应分类的 references/*.md。
分类：search / social (小红书/推特/B站/V2EX/Reddit/Facebook/Instagram) / career(LinkedIn) / dev(github) / web(网页/文章/RSS) / video(YouTube/B站/播客)。
items.notesZh: 全网调研/搜索：小红书、推特、B站、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub 等 15 个平台。

items.name: ask-matt
items.descriptionEn: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.
items.notesZh: 不知道该用哪个技能时问它：它会帮你路由到合适的技能或流程。

items.name: code-review
items.descriptionEn: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes — Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".
items.notesZh: 双维度代码评审：规范符合度 + 需求实现度，两边同时跑。

items.name: codebase-design
items.descriptionEn: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
items.notesZh: 设计"深模块"：优化模块接口、找拆分点、让代码更易测试、更易被 AI 理解。

items.name: diagnosing-bugs
items.descriptionEn: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
items.notesZh: 疑难 Bug 诊断循环：崩溃、报错、性能回退、卡顿的排查。

items.name: domain-modeling
items.descriptionEn: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.
items.notesZh: 打磨领域模型：统一团队术语、记录架构决策。

items.name: find-skills
items.descriptionEn: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
items.notesZh: 帮你发现和安装适合当前需求的技能。

items.name: grill-me
items.descriptionEn: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
items.notesZh: 一场"拷问式访谈"：把计划或设计打磨得更扎实（先提问再定方案）。

items.name: grill-with-docs
items.descriptionEn: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.
items.notesZh: 拷问式打磨计划，同时生成 ADR 和术语表文档。

items.name: grilling
items.descriptionEn: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.
items.notesZh: 不停追问直到达成共识：用"设计树"逐轮拷问你的计划。

items.name: handoff
items.descriptionEn: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.
items.notesZh: 把当前对话压缩成交接文档，方便另一个代理接手。

items.name: implement
items.descriptionEn: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.
items.notesZh: 按 spec 或工单实现一段具体工作。

items.name: improve-codebase-architecture
items.descriptionEn: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.
items.notesZh: 扫描代码库找改进机会，生成可视化 HTML 报告，再逐个拷问打磨。

items.name: officecli
items.descriptionEn: Create, analyze, proofread, and modify Office documents (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) using the officecli CLI tool. Use when the user wants to create, inspect, check formatting, find issues, add charts, or modify Office documents.
items.notesZh: 用 officecli 工具创建/检查/修改 Office 文档（.docx/.xlsx/.pptx）。

items.name: prototype
items.descriptionEn: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
items.notesZh: 快速搭一次性原型，验证某个状态模型或界面想法是否靠谱。

items.name: research
items.descriptionEn: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.
items.notesZh: 针对问题查权威一手资料，把结论写成 Markdown 存进仓库。

items.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
items.descriptionEn: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.
items.notesZh: 解决进行中的 git 合并/变基冲突。

items.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
items.descriptionEn: Configure this repo for the engineering skills — set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.
items.notesZh: 配置工程技能仓库：问题跟踪器、标签词表、文档布局（首次使用前跑一次）。

items.name: tdd
items.descriptionEn: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
items.notesZh: 测试驱动开发：先写测试再写实现（红-绿-重构）。

items.name: teach
items.descriptionEn: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
items.notesZh: 在这个工作区里教你一个新技能或概念。

items.name: to-questionnaire
items.descriptionEn: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.
items.notesZh: 把无法直接回答的决策转成问卷，交给别人填写。

items.name: to-spec
items.descriptionEn: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.
items.notesZh: 把当前对话整理成 spec 发布到问题跟踪器。

items.name: to-tickets
items.descriptionEn: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker.
items.notesZh: 把计划或 spec 拆成一组工单，发布到跟踪器。

items.name: triage
items.descriptionEn: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.
items.notesZh: 对 issue/外部 PR 分级处理：归类、验证、必要时拷问、写代理简报。

items.name: wait-what
items.descriptionEn: Stop. That last message did not land — re-pitch it.
items.notesZh: 当上一条消息没被理解时，喊停并换种方式重新表达。

items.name: wayfinder
items.descriptionEn: Plan a huge chunk of work — more than one agent session can hold — as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.
items.notesZh: 把超大任务拆成"决策工单地图"，逐个解决直到路径清晰。

items.name: wizard
items.descriptionEn: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.
items.notesZh: 生成交互式引导脚本，带人类一步步完成只能手动做的操作（如配密钥、建账号）。

items.name: writing-for-agents
items.descriptionEn: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
items.notesZh: 给代理写文档：创建/编辑技能、AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md。

items.name: firecrawl
items.notesZh: 网页抓取服务：把网页内容抓下来供 AI 分析，适合调研、爬取文章和站点（需要 API Key）。

items.name: node_repl
items.notesZh: 持久的 Node.js 执行环境：可跑 JS 脚本、控制浏览器（Playwright 等）、处理文件，Codex 内置。
